description.p: EDID Editor inspects and edits EDID (Extended Display Identification Data) structures. It supports EDID v1.3+ base blocks, CTA-861 extensions, and DisplayID data blocks. A visual timing editor and synchronized byte view make structured changes easier to inspect.
EDID Editor is based on wxEDID by Tomasz Pawlak.

Adds structural CTA-861 and DisplayID editing with Undo and Redo, safe audio and timing templates, hexadecimal import and export, text reports, opening of damaged EDID data, and field-level validation feedback. Decodes HDMI Forum, AMD FreeSync, and DisplayID 2.0 timing and range data, parses every CTA-861 extension, and opens the EDID of a connected display. Shows HDR luminance in cd/m², range limits above 255 Hz, native video formats, and standard timing names.

Adds an overview of the whole EDID, comparison with a file or a connected display, recent files, file drag and drop, on/off switches for single bits, plain field names with full descriptions, hidden reserved fields, and marking of a field’s bytes.
Initial GTK application with structured field editing, visual timing controls, search, byte inspection, and Undo and Redo support.
